description: Governed intent vocabulary for Trainstorm elements. TWO orthogonal dimensions: 'rhetorical' (what the element does communicatively — settled, from the existing schemas) and 'pedagogical' (the instructional job it does in the learning process — NEW, proposed here). These are independent of each other and of Bloom's cognitive level (a separate `bloom` field). An element may carry one of each.

governance.rule: Elements may only use ids defined here. New values require a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else (this is how 'complete' got caught in the Brunswick review).
governance.supplants: Prior scattered pedagogical-intent lists. Reconcile those into this file, then retire them.

rhetorical.description: What the element does on the page. Carried today in your course/scene JSON as `intent`. Listed here for completeness; treat as settled.

values.label: Orient
values.definition: Situates the reader; a heading or title that says what this is.

values.label: Refine
values.definition: Narrows or qualifies the orienting frame (subheads).

values.label: Organize
values.definition: Groups or labels a set (content/list heads).

values.label: Structure
values.definition: Arranges items into an ordered/parallel set (a list).

values.label: Specify
values.definition: A single concrete item within a set (a bullet).

values.label: Assert
values.definition: States a fact or claim plainly (a statement).

values.label: Explain
values.definition: Develops or reasons through an idea (a paragraph).

values.label: Persuade
values.definition: Lands an emphatic, affect-carrying point (an impact line).

values.label: Contextualize
values.definition: Frames with an external voice or perspective (a quote).

values.label: Transition
values.definition: Bridges between sections or ideas.

values.label: Support
values.definition: A subordinate aid — a callout, date, system note.

pedagogical.description: The instructional job the element (or scene) does in the learner's journey. Grounded in Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction, condensed for practical tagging. This is the proposed NEW dimension — the one to reconcile against your existing versions.
pedagogical.grounding: Gagné's Nine Events of Instruction (with Bloom/Merrill alignment noted per entry).
pedagogical.field: Proposed as element.intent.pedagogical (enum) — a small addition to element.schema.json.
pedagogical.render_routing_note: Pedagogical intent is a strong predictor of the `delivery` render target: `practice`/`feedback`/`assess` want behavior-driven (Storyline interaction); the rest are didactic and suit a true-timeline render (AE/Lottie). This lets `delivery` be derived, not hand-set.

values.label: Hook
values.definition: Gain attention and establish relevance — why this matters to the learner now.
values.brunswick_example: sce_001 Welcome — 'pay ranges now appear on all U.S. job postings.'

values.label: Objective
values.definition: State the goal / set expectations for what the learner will be able to do.

values.label: Activate
values.definition: Surface and connect to prior knowledge before introducing the new.
values.brunswick_example: sce_003 opener — 'it helps to understand how Brunswick sets pay in the first place.'

values.label: Present
values.definition: Deliver the new information or concept.
values.brunswick_example: sce_003 Three Principles; sce_004 how ranges are structured.

values.label: Exemplify
values.definition: Demonstrate, model, or illustrate with an example, analogy, or visual — the guidance that makes the concept concrete. (Where motion earns its keep.)
values.brunswick_example: sce_004 the min/midpoint/max range bar; sce_007 the total-rewards wheel.

values.label: Practice
values.definition: Elicit performance — let the learner do, choose, or explore.
values.brunswick_example: sce_005 click-to-reveal range zones; sce_009 conversation-starter cards.

values.label: Feedback
values.definition: Respond to the learner's performance — confirm, correct, or deepen.

values.label: Assess
values.definition: Measure mastery — a graded or gating check of understanding.

values.label: Reinforce
values.definition: Summarize and consolidate to aid retention.

values.label: Transfer
values.definition: Connect to real-world application or next action — the bridge from course to job.
values.brunswick_example: sce_008 'four things you can do right now'; the conversation starters as a job aid.
